name: bg-locker
description: interior of a grim football changing room, wooden benches, red and white kits hanging on pegs, tactics whiteboard with scribbles, steamy shower doorway, mud on tiled floor, harsh fluorescent light

name: bg-press
description: football press conference room, long table with microphones and water bottles, sponsor backdrop wall with red and white logos, rows of journalists and camera flashes in the foreground

name: bg-home
description: tacky english suburban kitchen diner at night, dinner table with cold plates of food, family photos, wine bottle, glowing tv in the corner, rain on window

name: bg-nightclub
description: seedy nightclub VIP booth, neon pink and purple lights, champagne bottles, velvet sofas, dance floor with silhouettes, disco ball

name: bg-boardroom
description: stern football association boardroom, long mahogany table, empty leather chairs, portraits of old men on walls, stacks of paperwork, grey daylight through tall windows

name: bg-doctor
description: dodgy football club medical room, treatment table, shelves of unlabelled pill bottles and syringes, skeleton model, flickering lamp, dirty sink

name: bg-prison
description: grim prison cell, metal bunk bed, steel toilet, barred window with moonlight, football poster taped to concrete wall

name: bg-newsroom
description: messy tabloid newspaper office at night, desks with old computers, piles of newspapers, headline mockups pinned to the wall, coffee cups, red printing press glow
